description: Homemade Sugar Cookies  Wet Ingredients * 1 cup unsalted butter, melted and cooled * 1 2/3 cups white granulated sugar, plus extra for rolling cookies before baking * 1 large egg + 1 large egg yolk, at room temperature * 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract Dry Ingredients * 2 1/2 cups all-purpose flour * 1 tsp baking soda * 1/2 tsp baking powder * 1/4 tsp salt Bake Temperature: 350°F Bake Time: 12–13 minutes Chill Time: 30 minutes Instructions 1. In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside. 2. In a separate bowl, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 2–3 minutes. 3. Add the vanilla extract, egg, and egg yolk. Mix until fully combined. 4. Gradually combine the wet and dry ingredients until a dough forms. 5. Scoop and roll the dough into balls. Place on a baking sheet and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. 6. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 7. Once chilled, place the cookie dough balls on a parchment-lined baking sheet. 8. Bake for 12–13 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown. 9. Remove from the oven and let cool for about 10 minutes before breaking into them 🫶🏽—or enjoy them warm with ice cream 🤪. #sugarcookies #homemadesugarcookies #cookierecipe #bakingfromscratch #zeetheintrovert
